scope: Independent local recalculation of the separate four cycles:u sample summaries and review of final IMAGE_C_E_PMU.md. Does not claim fresh raw perf.data decoding or physical-router attribution.
checks: The four windows match the separately frozen cycles plan exactly; the original16summary hash remains linked.
All sample counts, periods, mode/DSO/category sums and every per-range share/cross-run user-cycle estimate independently recompute.
Each function estimate uses original stat cycles:u median/5000, not instructions:u or kernel counters. Estimates including unknowns sum to their matched total.
Both C TCP instruction and cycle sample trees contain56descendants with exits; other scenes have no descendants.
All reported lost counts are zero; non-user PCs remain unknown rather than kernel-cost samples.
Final report gives all three-window stat ranges and labels sample estimates, emitted/inlined ranges, unknowns and Oracle-only limits.

report_claim_review.method: Share and estimate claims cross-checked against full emitted ranges, not treated as exact causal savings.

limitations: One cycle sample window per side/scene is a diagnostic ranking, not stable per-function precision or acceptance.
Higher UDP user cycles with only modestly higher instructions does not by itself establish allocator, cache-miss or any microarchitectural cause.
TCP Oracle kernel work is lower for E while device CPU is higher; do not combine environments as an exact gap decomposition.
